verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss publishes a per-endpoint API reference at docs.followupboss.com/reference, with documented parameters such as `fields`, `includeTrash` and smart-list filters. It also provides first-party Bash and PHP example scripts, but these live in a separate GitHub repo rather than running inside the reference. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (try-it console, in-page request execution), and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser try-it console, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can find Bash and PHP examples [here](https://github.com/FollowUpBoss/fub-api-examples)
Use the `fields` argument to request exactly the fields you need.
Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
